output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # full monochrome separator rows/columns; compress into number of bands
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if len(set(r))==1]
    cols=[j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1]
    nr=len(rows)+1; nc=len(cols)+1
    # tentative: fill with non-separator color (training)
    vals=[v for r in grid for v in r]
    sep=set(grid[i][0] for i in rows) | set(grid[0][j] for j in cols)
    fill=next((v for v in vals if v not in sep), vals[0])
    return [[fill]*nc for _ in range(nr)]"}
